title: EC2 Instance Configuration
description: Schema for validating terraform.tfvars.json files used by the EC2 provisioning module.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference used by editors such as VS Code.

account_id.description: AWS account ID where the EC2 instance will be deployed.

account_id_sharedservices.description: AWS Shared Services account ID used for centralized services such as backup, monitoring, logging, or IAM integrations.

instance_count.description: Number of EC2 instances to create.

instance_type.description: EC2 instance type, for example t3.medium, m5.xlarge, r7i.large.

ami_id.description: Optional custom AMI ID. If omitted, the module automatically selects an approved AMI based on os_type.

key_name.description: EC2 key pair name used for administrative access.

subnet_type.description: Subnet tier used for instance placement.

availability_zone.description: Specific Availability Zone for deployment. Leave null to allow automatic subnet selection.

subnet_id.description: Optional subnet ID. When specified, subnet discovery and subnet_type selection are bypassed.

root_disk_size.description: Root EBS volume size in GiB.

root_disk_iops.description: Provisioned IOPS for the root EBS volume.

ebs_volumes.description: Additional EBS volumes attached to the EC2 instance. Keys should represent device names.

encrypted.description: Whether the volume should be encrypted.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot ID used to create the volume.

schedule.description: Schedule tag value used by instance scheduling automation.

backup_plan.description: Backup plan tag value used by AWS Backup automation.

user_data_file.description: Name of a user-data script located in the userdata directory of the repository. The file contents are loaded and supplied during instance provisioning.

create_iam_instance_profile.description: Create a new IAM role and instance profile for the EC2 instance.

iam_instance_profile.description: Existing IAM instance profile name to use when create_iam_instance_profile is false.

iam_role_policies.description: Map of policy name to IAM policy ARN to attach to the generated IAM role.

security_group_ids.description: List of existing security groups to attach to the instance.

ingress_rules.description: Ingress rules used when a security group is automatically created by the module.

cidr_ipv4.description: IPv4 CIDR block allowed by the rule.

referenced_security_group_id.description: Source security group ID permitted by this rule.

tags.description: Additional tags applied to the rule.

additional_tags.description: Additional tags applied to the EC2 instance and attached resources.

instance_name.description: Value used for the Name tag of the EC2 instance.

create_default_sg.description: Create and manage a dedicated security group for this instance.

default_tags.description: Mandatory organisational tags applied to all resources.

Environment.description: Deployment environment such as dev, test, nonprod, or prod.

CostCenter.description: Financial cost centre responsible for the resource.

Source.description: Provisioning source reference such as GitHub repository, service request, or change request.
